ns2:section.sectionText: This discussion section will meet in C120 CLSL. Lectures will begin on Wednesday, January 20, 2016, and discussions will begin on Monday, January 25, 2016. Examinations will be held from 7:00-9:00PM on the following Wednesday evenings: February 10, March 9, and April 13, 2016. Students who enter the University Fall 2011 or later are responsible for additional course-based tuition of $300 unless they are already paying differential tuition during the term of course enrollment.
